bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
name=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name" 2>/dev/null)" = true || { echo STK_DOMAIN_BOT_DOWN; exit 61; }
docker exec "$name" node -e 'fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8766/health").then(r=>process.exit(r.status===200?0:2)).catch(()=>process.exit(3))' || { echo STK_LOCAL_SHOP_UNHEALTHY; exit 62; }
echo STK_LOCAL_SHOP_HEALTH=PASS
if ! command -v cloudflared >/dev/null 2>&1;then echo STK_NO_HOST_CLOUDFLARED_BINARY;exit 70;fi
found=0
for file in /etc/cloudflared/config.yml /etc/cloudflared/config.yaml "$HOME/.cloudflared/config.yml" "$HOME/.cloudflared/config.yaml";do
 test -f "$file" || continue
 if grep -Fq 'hentaigay.org' "$file";then found=1;fi
done
test "$found" -eq 1 || { echo STK_NO_EXISTING_HENTAI_ZONE_HOST_ROUTE;exit 71; }
echo STK_HENTAIGAY_STANDARD_CONFIG_ENTRY=PASS
